  ],
  "analytical_usefulness": 0.35,
  "source_groundedness": 0.55,
  "rationale": "The core design (per-company industry one-hot flags plus a geographic_region field) is genuinely well-matched to the query 'what company traits explain regional clustering' — it enables cross-tabulating industry against region. However, half of all columns are literal duplicates (the .1 set), contributing zero analytical value and dragging the holistic usefulness down substantially. Several industry flags also hallucinate labels not supported by the source text (23andMe and 280 Group tagged ai_ml; Accel tagged data_analytics; Addepar tagged cloud_infrastructure), while a few (healthcare_biotech, venture_capital, geographic_region) are soundly grounded. The concentration/penetration columns are largely derivable-but-redundant aggregates of region, and the penetration metric's fractional values are opaque and hard to verify against source text. Groundedness is mixed rather than broken."
